configuration_map: No geometric configuration exists. The proof operates entirely on magnitudes and ratios: A is an assigned line, B is defined by sq(B)=2*sq(A), and C is the mean proportional between A and B. All reasoning involves number-theoretic properties of ratios (square vs non-square numbers) and commensurability conclusions derived from Props 10.6, 10.7, 10.8, and 10.9. No points are placed inside/outside/on any figure, no angles are constructed or decomposed, and no rays are ordered.

This is typical of Book 10 propositions dealing with commensurability theory.
